text:
Anya (PM): Quick sync — timeline got pulled up 2 weeks. Need a decision for the 2026-04-15 milestone: what has to be in MVP vs what we cut to v1. My proposal: cut Admin Analytics and Custom Roles to v1, keep basic SSO (OIDC) for MVP, defer SAML. Thoughts?
Miguel (Eng Lead): OIDC only is doable within the new window. SAML spike would take 2 devs x 3 sprints if we want it production-grade (SCIM + cert rotation).
Leila (Solutions): Heads-up — ACME (top prospect) specifically asked for SAML. They said SAML is a gating requirement for pilots. If we drop SAML, we lose the pilot.
Sam (Product Eng): We can offer a temporary workaround: manual user provisioning + concierge onboarding for ACME. Not great UX but buys time.
Chris (CTO): If ACME moves ARR needle, we should consider a small focused delivery. Otherwise prefer to keep the release predictable and ship OIDC MVP.
Anya (PM): Proposal: two-track decision. If legal + sales confirm ACME is committed before EOD Fri, trigger SAML fast-track (scope: SAML + SCIM minimal, feature flag, audit logging). If not, cut SAML and Admin Analytics to v1. Everyone okay?
Miguel (Eng Lead): Need to surface infra risk — SAML + SCIM requires work on session/kv handling and test infra. Fast-track will bump timeline for other items.
Leila (Solutions): I'll ask Sales to get ACME written confirmation today. Also propose SLA in contract for the SAML delivery window.
Sam (Product Eng): For the v1 cutlist I'll create a trimmed milestone doc this afternoon: list of features, owners, and post-ship plan. Include rollout flags: 
```
flags:
  saml: off
  admin_analytics: off
  custom_roles: off
```
Anya (PM): Perfect. Action items: Leila -> ACME confirmation; Miguel -> estimate fast-track scope; Sam -> trimmed milestone doc by 3pm; Chris -> signoff on resource bump if ACME commits. Decision by EOD Fri. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
release-bot: Note: staging freeze starts 2026-04-08 00:00 UTC — any changes after that need an exception.
Leila (Solutions): Confirmed — Sales will push for written commitment. Will update here when I have it.
Miguel (Eng Lead): Estimating 2-sprint fast-track; will post a scoped list by EOD today.
Anya (PM): Thanks — we'll reconvene Thurs 10am if needed.
